_README: Male upper-arm muscles by the compartment rules on his cryosection photographs, v2 (scripts/cryo/vhm_arm_muscles_v2.py): humerus located in the photograph, each arm island registered to his CT by centroid; rule-based, derived data.
Brachialis band 32 mm (Q52): calibrated so the rule reproduces his fascia-traced v1 brachialis (133/189 cm3; band 22 gave 74/105, 28 111/145, 34 154/192). Coracobrachialis band 15 mm.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male cryosections and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons.
